findings.title: GO mechanics ambiguity — which registry copy the consumption must reach
findings.detail: Real-mode gate reads THIS worktree's mirror of plans/CYCLE_REGISTRY.json (frozen at branch point: EXEC row phase 'REGISTERED (planned)', head 000000000000). Verifier demonstrated (read-only, tmp token + real worktree registry path): exec_go_state refuses with "registry phase 'REGISTERED (planned)' does not record GO_CONSUMED" even with a verbatim-correct token present. Canonical ROOT researchctl consumption updates only the root copy; OWNER_GO_PACKET.md step 1 does not say which copy, and AGENTS.md documents researchctl from the ROOT. Until the registry copy the gate reads records GO_CONSUMED, run-day refuses exit 3 with a self-explanatory message. Fail-closed in every direction — no unlawful opening possible; zero data risk.
findings.remediation: One line in the owner/controller plane: consume GO into the registry copy the gate reads (run researchctl from the worktree, or sync the root copy into <wt>/plans/), or point the gate's real-mode registry read at the canonical root path; say which in OWNER_GO_PACKET.md step 1.
